clearer_why: A's labels sit on their lines and each fan-out arrow lands on its target with the label next to it (prompt, search, execute, draw, events). In B five long parallel lines run down the right side and the labels float beside them, so it is hard to tell which line goes where; persist/ingest from the Event bus are ambiguous.
looks_why: A is compact and balanced, with a tidy fan-out and distinct line weights for the main prompt path and dashed events. B has nicer typography and an orange highlight, but the tall bundle of parallel lines and the loose layout look tangled.
weak_A: plain styling, small text, and the fan-out lines from Agent run tightly parallel
weak_B: long parallel line bundle down the right side and floating labels make routing hard to follow
